A1.name: Beginner
A1.canDo: Introduce yourself, order food, ask for the way, fill in a form.

A2.name: Elementary
A2.canDo: Talk about your day, your work and your plans; deal with the Bürgeramt.

B1.name: Intermediate
B1.canDo: Follow a conversation at work, write an email, say what you think and why.

B2.name: Upper intermediate
B2.canDo: Take part in meetings, read the news, apply for a job in German.

C1.name: Advanced
C1.canDo: Study or work fully in German; the level most universities ask for.
